description: For house cleaning, this inspection checklist records included tasks, excluded areas, soil conditions, products, add-ons, crew plan, duration, and price basis. Its supporting evidence includes pre-service condition photos, customer instructions, task completion record, exception photos, and supply use.

sections.title: Service Visit Reference

blocks.guidance: Mark each house cleaning item after direct review.
items: Entry, living areas, and reachable surfaces match the agreed task list
Kitchen counters, sink, appliance exteriors, and floor are complete
Bathrooms, mirrors, fixtures, and floors are complete
Bedrooms and requested rotation items are complete
Trash, supplies, fragile items, pets, keys, and access are accounted for
Missed areas, damage concerns, add-ons, and customer notes are recorded

subtitle: House Cleaning Inspection Checklist: home cleaning estimate, dispatch, and acceptance using service address, included tasks, and pre-service condition photos.
title: House Cleaning Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during home cleaning estimate, dispatch, and acceptance when the house cleaning record must identify service address, rooms, surfaces, occupants, pets, access, customer priorities, and fragile items. Complete the applicable handoff for room-by-room verification, exception resolution, customer acceptance, recurring preferences, and payment handoff.
